items.title: Breaking Bad item
items.description: A single Breaking Bad run: a baseline score-based search algorithm (GES, XGES, OPS, or LGES) optionally perturbed with the paper's component-wise parent-deletion operator.

baseline.description: Base search algorithm. Note: "boss" is not supported here -- it requires an initial graph produced separately by BOSS/Tetrad, which this module does not provide (see RESTORE_GUIDE.md Section 7 in LGAI-Research/breaking-bad).

variant.description: Perturbation strategy. 0: no perturbation (vanilla baseline). 1: single-edge deletion (XGES-style). 2: component-wise parent deletion (the paper's proposed DP operator, Algorithm 2). 3: three-phase scheduled perturbation (DP -> single-node -> single-edge).

alpha.description: Penalty parameter (lambda) for the Gaussian BIC score.

delete_op.description: Hub node deletion option passed to Search's --delete_op flag.
